title: Application for tax break on housing at 160-159 Realty, Manhattan
summary: This resolution would approve a real property tax exemption for a housing project at Block 2109, Lot 17 and Block 2118, Lot 11 in Manhattan, under state law for affordable housing nonprofits. The exemption would run for up to 40 years from an effective date tied to the property's transfer to a housing development fund company, subject to a regulatory agreement with the city housing agency. The tax break would end early if the owner fails to meet the agreement's requirements or transfers the property without approval.
